cards.name: Abattoir
cards.text: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic melee attack. Abattoir can be cast only once per turn.

cards.name: Abuse
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warbeast gains +2 SPD and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn but suffers d3 damage points.

cards.name: Abyssal Gate
cards.text: When Abyssal Gate damages a non-Leader enemy model, after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. A model can be placed by Abyssal Gate only once per turn.

cards.name: Admonition
cards.text: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

cards.name: Aerogenesis
cards.text: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models/units beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and Flight during their activations. Aerogenesis lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Affliction
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point.

cards.name: Aggravator
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction warbeasts gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

cards.name: Airburst
cards.text: Target any model in the spellcaster’s control range, ignoring LOS. When resolving Airburst, ignore cover, concealment, and Stealth.

cards.name: Annihilation
cards.text: Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

cards.name: Arcane Blast
cards.text: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

cards.name: Arcane Might
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models can spend 1 focus or fury point on the spellcaster to boost a melee attack or melee damage roll during their activations.

cards.name: Arcane Propulsion
cards.text: Target non-huge based Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

cards.name: Arcane Shield
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 ARM.

cards.name: Arcane Ward
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

cards.name: Arcantrik Bolt
cards.text: A warjack damaged by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

cards.name: Artifice of Deviation
cards.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain cover. Enemy models treat the template as rough terrain.

cards.name: Ashes to Ashes
cards.text: If target model is directly hit, the d3 nearest enemy models within 4" of it suffer a POW 10 fire damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve damage resulting from Ashes to Ashes simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that directly hit.

cards.name: Assail
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warjack can charge or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. The warjack gains +2 SPD when it charges or makes a slam or trample power attack. Models slammed by the warjack are moved +2".

cards.name: Avatar of Slaughter
cards.text: Target the Old Witch or Scrapjack. The affected model gains +2 MAT, +2 to its melee damage rolls, Berserk, and Overtake. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

cards.name: Avenging Force
cards.text: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in the spellcaster’s control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can advance 3" and make one basic attack.

cards.name: Awakened Spirit
cards.text: Target warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can cast its animus once during its activation without being forced. A warbeast that casts its animus as a result of Awakened Spirit cannot also be forced to cast its animus that activation.

cards.name: Backlash
cards.text: When target enemy warjack that is part of a battlegroup is damaged, its controller suffers 1 damage point.

cards.name: Banishing Ward
cards.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target friendly model/unit expire. Affected models cannot be targeted by enemy spells or animi.

cards.name: Batten Down the Hatches
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup cannot become knocked down and gain +3 ARM but suffer –2 DEF. Batten Down the Hatches lasts for one round.

cards.name: Battering Ram
cards.text: An enemy model hit by Battering Ram can be pushed 3" directly away from the spell’s point of origin.

cards.name: Battle Lust
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains an additional die on melee damage rolls but suffers –2 DEF.

cards.name: Befuddle
cards.originLeader: Bohdan Lesnoi, Apostle of the Witch
cards.text: On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.

cards.name: Bestial
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models cannot cast non-animus spells or be used to channel spells. Bestial lasts for one round.

cards.name: Black Spot
cards.text: Target enemy warrior model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a friendly Faction model destroys one or more affected models with a basic melee or ranged attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one additional melee or ranged attack. Attacks gained from Black Spot cannot generate additional attacks from Black Spot.

cards.name: Black Talons
cards.text: On a critical hit, models hit suffer Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

cards.name: Blackest Night
cards.text: While within 10" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 to their attack rolls. Blackest Night lasts for one round.

cards.name: Bladed Gale
cards.text: Models hit lose Flight for one round.

cards.name: Bleed
cards.text: When Bleed damages a living enemy model, this model can remove d3 damage points.

cards.name: Blinding Light
cards.text: A model/unit hit by this spell cannot make ranged or arcane attacks and suffers –2 DEF for one round.

cards.name: Blood Mark
cards.text: Target enemy model suffers –2 ARM. The spellcaster can transfer damage from an enemy attack to the affected model one time, then Blood Mark expires.

cards.name: Blood of Kings
cards.text: The spellcaster gains +3 SPD, MAT, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, the spellcaster gains +3 to its melee attack damage rolls. Blood of Kings lasts for one round.

cards.name: Blood of Liberty
cards.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Llaelese models gain Tough and +2 ARM.

cards.name: Blood Rain
cards.text: Blood Rain causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

cards.name: Blood Spiller
cards.text: Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Blood Spiller without being forced for one turn.

cards.name: Blood Thorn
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect: Corrosion.

cards.name: Blow the Man Down
cards.text: A model hit by Blow the Man Down becomes knocked down. On a critical hit, instead of suffering a normal damage roll a non-incorporeal model hit is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

cards.name: Blur
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +3 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks.

cards.name: Bombshell
cards.text: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.

cards.name: Bond of Gristle & Bone
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 ARM and Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or magic attacks while knocked down.)

cards.name: Boundless Charge
cards.originLeader: Anson Durst, Rock of the Faith
cards.text: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Brand of Fire
cards.text: Brand of Fire causes fire damage. On a hit, the target model and the d3 nearest enemy models within 3" of it suffer the Fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Brand of Heresy
cards.text: Cohort models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain boosted attack and damage rolls against target model/unit.

cards.name: Breath of Corruption
cards.text: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

cards.name: Breath Stealer
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

cards.name: Broadside
cards.text: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. Broadside can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Bullet Dodger
cards.originLeader: Calandra Truthsayer, Oracle of the Glimmerwood
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

cards.name: Bulwark
cards.originLeader: Anson Durst, Rock of the Faith
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

cards.name: Burning Ash
cards.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Immunity: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

cards.name: Calamity
cards.text: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM.

cards.name: Carnage
cards.text: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to melee attack rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s control range. Carnage lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Carnivore
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack rolls against living models. When an affected model destroys a living or undead model with a melee attack, the destroyed model is removed from play and the spellcaster can remove d3 damage points.

cards.name: Carrion Feast
cards.text: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

cards.name: Castigate
cards.text: Enemy models cannot be used to channel spells or be forced to cast an animus while in the spellcaster’s control range. Castigate lasts for one round.

cards.name: Caustic Mist
cards.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

cards.name: Censure
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: Enemy upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire. A model can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell. Roll a separate d3 for each spell. This damage cannot be transferred or reduced by spending focus points. Remove one damage point from the spellcaster for each damage point caused by Censure. Censure can be cast only one per activation.

cards.name: Chain Lightning
cards.text: A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage from the attack that caused the leap.

cards.name: Chasten
cards.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on target model/unit damaged by this attack expire.

cards.name: Chosen Ground
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Pathfinder and cannot become knocked down.

cards.name: Cleansing Fire
cards.originLeader: Anson Durst, Rock of the Faith
cards.text: Cleansing Fire causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Cloak of Ash
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ashen Veil. (A model with Ashen Veil has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Ashen Veil.)

cards.name: Cold Front
cards.text: The spellcaster gains Chiller for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

cards.name: Convection
cards.text: When Convection destroys a living enemy model, you can give 1 focus point to a warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range.

cards.name: Countermeasure
cards.text: While within 5" of target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

cards.name: Coup de Main
cards.text: The spellcaster and friendly Privateer models activating in its control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Affected warjacks can charge without spending a focus point. Coup de Main lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Creator’s Wrath
cards.text: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls and its melee weapons gains Blessed.

cards.name: Crevasse
cards.text: If Crevasse boxes its original target, you can make a SP 6 attack using the boxed model as the attack’s point of origin. Models hit suffer a POW 12 magical damage roll. Models boxed by Crevasse are removed from play.

cards.name: Crippling Grasp
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 SPD, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, an affected model suffers –2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

cards.name: Crusader's Call
cards.text: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain +2 SPD. Crusader’s Call lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Curse of Shadows
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 ARM. A model can advance through an affected model if it has enough movement to move completely past its base.

cards.name: Cursed Fate
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF. When a damage roll resulting from a direct hit fails to exceed the ARM of an affected model, the model suffers 1 damage point. Cursed Fate lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Cyclone
cards.text: The spellcaster immediately makes a full advance. At the end of this movement, the spellcaster can make one basic melee attack against each model in its LOS that is in its melee range. Cyclone can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Damnation
cards.text: Warjacks in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make slam power attacks against target model without spending focus. They can ignore forests and cloud effects when determining LOS when declaring a charge or slam attack against the affected model. They gain +2" movement and Pathfinder when resolving charges or slam power attacks targeting the affected model.

cards.name: Dark Fire
cards.text: When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

cards.name: Dark Guidance
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their melee attack rolls this turn.

cards.name: Dark Path
cards.text: Dark Path can be cast only while Cassius is in Wurmwood’s control range. Immediately place Cassius completely within 2" of Wurmwood or place Wurmwood completely within 2" of Cassius. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Dark Path.

cards.name: Dark Seduction
cards.text: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

cards.name: Dark Unraveling
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Dark Unraveling lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Dark Waves
cards.originLeader: Skarre, Admiral of the Black Fleet
cards.text: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement this activation, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Dark Waves expires. A model can be placed as a result of Dark Waves only once per turn.

cards.name: Dash
cards.text: The spellcaster and friendly Faction warrior models activating in its control range gain +1 SPD. Dash lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Dauntless Resolve
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +3 ARM and Tough.

cards.name: Deadeye
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains an additional die on its next ranged attack roll this turn.

cards.name: Deadweight
cards.text: When Deadweight destroys an enemy living or undead model, choose an enemy model within 2" of it. The chosen model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

cards.name: Death March
cards.text: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 MAT and Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

cards.name: Death Pact
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and Undead. Death Pact lasts for one round.

cards.name: Death Rattle
cards.text: When Death Rattle boxes a living or undead non-Leader enemy warrior model, you can immediately take control of the model. The boxed model immediately makes one basic attack, then it is removed from play.

cards.name: Death Sentence
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model misses target enemy model/unit with an attack, it can reroll the attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Death Sentence.

cards.name: Death to Dust
cards.text: A model boxed by this attack is removed from play.

cards.name: Death Ward
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. If an affected warjack is damaged, choose which column suffers the damage.

cards.name: Deathbringers
cards.text: While within the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Grievous Wounds. Deathbringers lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

cards.name: Deceleration
cards.originLeader: Anson Durst, Rock of the Faith
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

cards.name: Defender's Ward
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and ARM.

cards.name: Deflection
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks. Deflection lasts for one round.

cards.name: Discontinuity
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the melee weapons of models in its battlegroup gain Dispel. (When a weapon with Dispel hits a model/unit, upkeep spells and animi on that model/unit immediately expire.)

cards.name: Discord
cards.originLeader: Grissel Bloodsong, Marshal of the Kriels
cards.text: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Wailing. (While within 5" of a model with Wailing, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.)

cards.name: Disintegration
cards.text: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.

cards.name: Dissolution Bolt
cards.text: A model hit by Dissolution Bolt cannot channel spells for one round.

cards.name: Distraction
cards.text: Target warrior model/unit cannot make ranged attacks and suffers –2 DEF and MAT for one round.

cards.name: Dog Pile
cards.text: Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can charge or make slam power attacks against target model without being forced. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can ignore forests and cloud effects when determining LOS when declaring a charge or slam attack against the affected model. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder when resolving charges or slam power attacks targeting the affected model.

cards.name: Domination
cards.text: Take control of target enemy warjack that has a non-crippled cortex. You can make a full advance with the warjack and can then make one basic attack, then Domination expires. Domination can be cast only once per activation. A warjack can be affected by Domination only once per turn.

cards.name: Doom Spiral
cards.text: When Doom Spiral damages a warjack that is part of a battlegroup, its controller suffers d3 damage points.

cards.name: Dragon’s Blood
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM. When an affected model is disabled by a melee attack, the attacker suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

cards.name: Earth Spikes
cards.text: When making this attack, ignore cover and concealment. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

cards.name: Earth’s Sanctuary
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

cards.name: Easy Rider
cards.text: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Pathfinder. Easy Rider lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Electrical Blast
cards.text: Electrical Blast causes electrical damage. Warjacks damaged by Electrical Blast suffer Disruption.

cards.name: Electrify
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, Resistance: Electricity, and Repulsor Field. (When a model model with Repulsor Field is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from that model.)

cards.name: Electro Bolt
cards.text: Electro Bolt causes electrical damage.

cards.name: Eliminator
cards.text: Immediately after this attack is resolved, the spellcaster can advance up to 2" for each enemy model destroyed by the attack.

cards.name: Energizer
cards.text: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range can immediately advance up to 2". Energizer can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Enfeeble
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 to attack and damage rolls.

cards.name: Engine of Destruction
cards.text: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.

cards.name: Eruption
cards.text: This attack causes fire damage. On a hit, center a cloud effect on the model targeted. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Fire entering or ending its activation in the AOE suffer the Fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Eruption of Life
cards.text: If this attack destroys a living or undead enemy model, center a 3" template on the destroyed model, then remove that model from play. The template is forest terrain that remains in play for one round. Enemy models in the template when it is put into play suffer an unboostable POW 13 blast damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack.

cards.name: Eruption of Spines
cards.text: If target model is hit, the d3 nearest models within 5" of it suffer a POW 10 damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Eruption of Spines damage rolls are simultaneous.

cards.name: Escort
cards.text: Cohort models in the spellcaster's battlegroup beginning their activations in the spellcaster's control range gain +2 SPD when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. The spellcaster gains +2 ARM while one or more cohort models in its battlegroup are within 3" of it.

cards.name: Even Ground
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down. Even Ground lasts for one round.

cards.name: Excarnate
cards.text: When a living enemy warrior model is boxed by Excarnate, remove it from play. You can then add one Grunt to a friendly Faction small-based undead unit in the spellcaster’s control range. Place the Grunt within 1" of another model in the unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

cards.name: Explosivo
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model’s ranged weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. If the affected model directly hits and boxes an enemy model with an attack from a ranged weapon, models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 8 magical blast damage roll, then the boxed model is removed from play.

cards.name: Fail-Safe
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

cards.name: Feast of Worms
cards.text: Center a cloud template on the model directly hit. The template is a hazard and remains in play as long as upkeep is paid. While in the template, enemy models suffer –2 ARM. When a living enemy model is destroyed in the template, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

cards.name: Fire For Effect
cards.text: Boost the attack and damage rolls of target friendly Faction model’s first ranged attack each activation.

cards.name: Fire Group
cards.text: While models in the spellcaster's battlegroup are in its control range, their ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Fire Group lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Fire Step
cards.text: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll . After the damage is resolved, place the spellcaster completely within 2" of its current location. Fire Step can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Firepower
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.

cards.name: Firestarter
cards.text: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup. That model’s melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

cards.name: Flashing Blade
cards.text: The spellcaster immediately makes one basic attack with one of its melee weapons against each enemy model in its LOS that is in the weapon’s melee range. These attacks are simultaneous.

cards.name: Flesh Eater
cards.text: When a living enemy model is damaged by Flesh Eater, the spellcaster or a living warbeast in its battlegroup and in its control range can remove d3 damage points.

cards.name: Flesh Hooks
cards.text: Target living or undead model damaged by Flesh Hooks cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

cards.name: Flicker
cards.text: Place models in Caine’s battlegroup currently in his control range anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations. Flicker can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Fog of War
cards.text: Models gain concealment while in the spellcaster’s control range.

cards.name: Force Blast
cards.text: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Enemy models currently within 2" of the target model are pushed 4" directly away from it in the order you choose.

cards.name: Force Field
cards.text: The spellcaster cannot become knocked down. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

cards.name: Force Hammer
cards.text: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.

cards.name: Force Strike
cards.originLeader: Calandra Truthsayer, Oracle of the Glimmerwood
cards.text: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

cards.name: Forced Evolution
cards.text: Target friendly living Faction warbeast gains +2 DEF and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls

cards.name: Forced Induction
cards.text: Target enemy warjack gains 1 focus point. Then the warjack and enemy models within 1" for each focus point on it suffer an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll.

cards.name: Foresight
cards.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Foresight.

cards.name: Fortify
cards.text: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM. That model and any friendly models B2B with it cannot become knocked down, be pushed, or be moved by a slam.

cards.name: Fortune
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit can reroll its missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fortune.

cards.name: Freezing Grip
cards.text: Target model/unit without Resistance: Cold becomes stationary for one round.

cards.name: Freezing Mist
cards.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 to attack rolls.

cards.name: Frost Field
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Chiller. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

cards.name: Frostbite
cards.text: Frostbite causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

cards.name: Full Throttle
cards.text: Warjacks in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus that activation. While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted melee attack rolls. Full Throttle lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Fury’s Strength
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

cards.name: Gallows
cards.text: When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Gallows’ point of origin.

cards.name: Ghost Walk
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

cards.name: Goad
cards.text: Target Cohort model in this model's battlegroup immediately gains 1 focus point.

cards.name: Grave Wind
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains +2 DEF and Poltergeist. (When an enemy model misses a model with Poltergeist with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from the model with Poltergeist.)

cards.name: Grind
cards.text: When a warjack is hit by Grind, it suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement system box.

cards.name: Ground Zero
cards.text: Other models within 3" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 blast damage roll. Immediately after this damage is resolved each enemy model damaged by Ground Zero is pushed d6" directly away from the spellcaster in the order you choose.

cards.name: Guided Fire
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted ranged attack rolls for one turn.

cards.name: Guided Hand
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on each model’s next melee attack roll this turn.

cards.name: Hallowed Avenger
cards.originLeader: Anson Durst, Rock of the Faith
cards.text: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains Righteous Vengeance. (If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of a model with Righteous Vengeance during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase the model with Righteous Vengeance can advance up to 3" and make one basic attack.)

cards.name: Hand of Destruction
cards.text: Friendly models in this model’s battlegroup gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

cards.name: Hand of the Creator
cards.text: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly Faction model currently in the spellcaster’s control range. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Harvest
cards.text: When a living or undead enemy model is destroyed in the spellcaster’s control range, the spellcaster can gain 1 fury point. The spellcaster’s fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Harvest.

cards.name: Heightened Reflexes
cards.text: Target friendly model can not be knocked down or made stationary for one round.

cards.name: Hellbound
cards.text: The spellcaster cannot be targeted by charges or slam power attacks. While within 5" of the spellcaster, enemy models treat open ground as rough terrain. Hellbound lasts for one round.

cards.name: Hellfire
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

cards.name: Hellmouth
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: On a direct hit, before making the damage roll, push models within 2" of the model directly hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by Hellmouth are removed from play.

cards.name: Hellwrought
cards.text: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can advance up to 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

cards.name: Hex Blast
cards.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

cards.name: Hex Hammer
cards.text: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while in this model’s control range, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect. Hex Hammer lasts for one round.

cards.name: High Ground
cards.text: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid. While completely within the template, models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks and their ranged weapons gain Arcing Fire. (When attacking with a weapon with Arcing Fire, a model can ignore intervening models.)

cards.name: Hoarfrost
cards.text: Hoarfrost causes cold damage. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

cards.name: Hollow
cards.text: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 ARM. Once per turn, when an affected model is disabled by an enemy attack, replace it with a friendly Void Spirit model. A model replaced by Hollow is destroyed.

cards.name: Host of Shadows
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Ghostly. Host of Shadows lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

cards.name: Hot-Shot
cards.text: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

cards.name: Howling Flames
cards.text: Howling Flames causes fire damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Hunter’s Mark
cards.text: Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter’s Mark lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Icy Grip
cards.text: Target model hit without Resistance: Cold suffers –2 SPD for one round.

cards.name: Ignite
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls. Affected models gain Critical Fire on their melee attacks.

cards.name: Immolation
cards.text: Immolation causes fire damage. On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Impending Doom
cards.text: Enemy models within 5" of the spellcaster are pushed 5" directly toward it in the order you choose.

cards.name: Incite
cards.originLeader: Bohdan Lesnoi, Apostle of the Witch
cards.text: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to attack and damage rolls against enemy models while the enemy models are within 10" of the spellcaster. Incite lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Infernal Machine
cards.text: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Murderous and +2 SPD. (A model with Murderous gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.)

cards.name: Influence
cards.text: Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

cards.name: Inhospitable Ground
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models treat open terrain as rough terrain. Inhospitable Ground lasts for one round.

cards.name: Inviolable Resolve
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down or moved by a push or a slam.

cards.name: Invocation of Blood
cards.text: If Bethayne is flesh melded with Belphagor when this spell is cast, Belphagor gains +2 SPD, DEF, and ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round. Otherwise, Bethayne immediately makes a full advance toward Belphagor. Invocation of Blood can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Invocations of Wrath
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Invocations of Wrath lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Iron Aggression
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warjack can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

cards.name: Iron Flesh
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

cards.name: Jackhammer
cards.text: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

cards.name: Jumpstart
cards.text: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are currently in its control range stand up and are no longer stationary. Models that were knocked down this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.

cards.name: Killing Ground
cards.text: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge in the spellcaster’s control range gain Pathfinder. Warbeasts in the spellcaster’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can charge or make slam power attacks against enemy models without being forced. Killing Ground lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Lamentation
cards.text: When an enemy model casts a spell while in the spellcaster’s control range, double the COST of the spell. Additionally, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells on models/units in the spellcaster’s control range.

cards.name: Last Stand
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains an additional die on its melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model makes a melee attack, it is destroyed at the end of the turn.

cards.name: Lifebound
cards.text: Target friendly living model/unit gains Shield Guard. When an affected model is destroyed by an enemy attack, the spellcaster gains its soul token. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

cards.name: Lightning Storm
cards.text: On a direct hit, center a cloud effect template on the model hit. The cloud is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll.

cards.name: Lightning Tendrils
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Resistance: Electricity. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap.

cards.name: Lock the Target
cards.text: A model damaged by Lock the Target cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

cards.name: Locked Horns
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Unyielding. Locked Horns lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

cards.name: Locomotion
cards.text: The spellcaster spends up to 3 focus points to cast Locomotion. Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup immediately advances up to 1" for each focus point spent. A Cohort model can be targeted by Locomotion only once per activation.

cards.name: Mage Sight
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Eyeless Sight.

cards.name: Magic Bullet
cards.text: If target friendly Faction model’s next basic ranged attack directly hits, after resolving the attack choose another model within 4" of the model hit. The chosen model suffers an unboostable POW 12 magical damage roll. The point of origin for this damage is the model hit. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After resolving this damage roll, Magic Bullet expires. Magic Bullet lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Magnetic Hold
cards.text: Target enemy model/unit suffers –2 SPD and DEF and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Friendly Faction construct models charging an affected model gain +2 SPD.

cards.name: Malediction
cards.text: While within 2" of the spellcaster, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and ARM.

cards.name: Manifest Destiny
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Manifest Destiny lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Mantrap
cards.text: On a direct hit, warrior models hit become knocked down.

cards.name: Marathon
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

cards.name: Marked for Death
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF, loses Incorporeal and Stealth and cannot gain Incorporeal or Stealth while affected by Marked for Death.

cards.name: Martial Paragon
cards.text: The spellcaster gains an additional die on melee attack rolls and Unstoppable.

cards.name: Mirage
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

cards.name: Mobility
cards.text: Models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

cards.name: Mortality
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers –2 DEF and ARM, loses Tough, and cannot have damage removed from it. Mortality lasts for one round.

cards.name: Mosh Pit
cards.text: Knocked down friendly Faction models in the spellcaster’s control range immediately stand up. While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models' melee weapons gain Knockdown. Mosh Pit lasts for one turn. (When a model is hit with an attack by a weapon with Knockdown, it becomes knocked down.)

cards.name: Murder of Crows
cards.originLeader: Bohdan Lesnoi, Apostle of the Witch
cards.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. An enemy model that enters or ends its activation in the AOE suffers an unboostable POW 8 damage roll.

cards.name: Mutagenesis
cards.text: Target enemy model boxed by Mutagenesis is removed from play. When Mutagenesis boxes an enemy model and the spellcaster was the spell’s point of origin, the spellcaster can replace the boxed model when it is removed from play. The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after replacing another model as a result of Mutagenesis. Mutagenesis can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Muzzle
cards.text: An enemy warbeast damaged by Muzzle cannot advance toward the spellcaster for one round.

cards.name: Mystic Wards
cards.text: Enemy animi and enemy upkeep spells on models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that are in its control range immediately expire. Enemy arcane attacks targeting a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup suffer –5 RNG. Mystic Wards lasts for one round.

cards.name: Night’s Reflection
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

cards.name: Obliteration
cards.text: On a critical hit, models hit are knocked down.

cards.name: Occult Whispers
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their Arcane Attack rolls. Occult Whispers lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Occultation
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.text: The spellcaster and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in its control range gain Relentless Charge for one turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

cards.name: Open Fire
cards.text: Target Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make one basic ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Open Fire only once per turn.

cards.name: Overrun
cards.text: When target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models with an attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved one other model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can make a full advance, then Overrun expires. A model can advance only once per turn as a result of Overrun. Overrun lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Parasite
cards.text: Target model/unit suffers -3 ARM and the spellcaster gains +1 ARM.

cards.name: Penitence
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit. When one or more affected models are damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacker suffers 1 point of fire damage unless it has Immunity: Fire.

cards.name: Perdition
cards.text: When an enemy model is damaged by Perdition, immediately after the attack is resolved the spellcaster or one model in its battlegroup that is currently in its control range can advance up to 5" directly toward the nearest enemy model. A model can advance as a result of Perdition only once per turn.

cards.name: Phantasm
cards.text: When target friendly Faction model/unit is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers –5 RNG.

cards.name: Phantom Hunter
cards.text: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup ignores LOS when making charges and attacks. That model ignores concealment, cover, and Stealth when resolving attacks. Phantom Hunter lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Pillar of Salt
cards.text: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not overlap a model's base. The template is considered to be a friendly huge-based construct model. The template has DEF 5 and ARM 20, and is removed from play if it suffers 1 or more damage points. The template has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down, placed, or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks. The template remains in play for one round.

cards.name: Pin Cushion
cards.text: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on ranged attack and ranged damage rolls against target model/unit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

cards.name: Playing God
cards.text: Target friendly living Faction warbeast is affected by Spontaneous Mutation effects while they affect Absylonia. Additionally, once per turn Absylonia can transfer damage to the affected warbeast without spending fury.

cards.name: Polarity Shield
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Polarity Field. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

cards.name: Positive Charge
cards.text: Target friendly Faction Cohort model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. While within 3" of the affected Cohort model, other friendly Faction models gain +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Positive Charge lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Powder Keg
cards.text: On a critical hit, the model directly hit loses its initial attacks and cannot make power attacks or special attacks for one round.

cards.name: Primed
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls. If an affected model is disabled by an enemy attack, models within 1" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll and the affected model is removed from play.

cards.name: Psychic Assault
cards.text: This spell ignores LOS.

cards.name: Psychic Vampire
cards.text: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while in this model's control range, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers 1 damage point and this model can remove 1 damage point. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

cards.name: Psycho Surgery
cards.text: Each model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup currently in its control range can immediately remove d3 + 1 damage points. This spell can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Puissance
cards.text: Target friendly model/unit gains +2 to its melee damage rolls and its melee weapons gain Beat Back. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it".)

cards.name: Purification
cards.text: Continuous effects, animi, and upkeep spells in the spellcaster’s control range immediately expire.

cards.name: Pursuit
cards.text: If target enemy model/unit advances during its activation, one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can immediately make a full advance.

cards.name: Quagmire
cards.text: While B2B with target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and cannot advance.

cards.name: Quicken
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 SPD and DEF against ranged and magic attack rolls.

cards.name: Rampager
cards.originLeader: Hoarluk Doomshaper, Shaman of the Gnarls
cards.text: Take control of target enemy warbeast. You can make one full advance with the warbeast and can then make one basic attack, then Rampager expires. While the warbeast is affected by Rampager, it cannot be forced and you cannot use its animus. Rampager can be cast only once per activation. A warbeast can be affected by Rampager only once per turn.

cards.name: Rapid Growth
cards.text: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is forest terrain that remains in play as long as its upkeep is paid.

cards.name: Rapport
cards.text: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can use the spellcaster’s current MAT and RAT in place of its own. When checking to see if the affected Cohort model is in its controller’s control range, double the range.

cards.name: Ravager
cards.text: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains Berserk. While affected by Ravager, a model cannot make Chain Attacks. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.)

cards.name: Razor Wall
cards.text: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers 1 damage point.

cards.name: Razor Wind
cards.text: On a critical hit on a warjack or warbeast, fill in the unmarked damage boxes or circles on the last column or branch damaged.

cards.name: Reconstruct
cards.text: When target large-based or smaller Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each system or aspect, then Reconstruct expires.

cards.name: Redline
cards.text: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

cards.name: Refuge
cards.text: At the end of an activation in which target friendly Faction model hit an enemy model with an attack, the affected model can make a full advance.

cards.name: Repudiate
cards.originLeader: Constance Blaize, Knight of the Prophet
cards.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Repudiate immediately expire. When an upkeep spell expires as a result of Repudiate, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

cards.name: Respawn
cards.text: When target large-based or smaller warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup is disabled by an enemy attack place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Remove 1 damage point from each aspect, then Respawn expires.

cards.name: Restoration
cards.text: Target friendly Faction unit gains +2 ARM. During your Control Phase, the spellcaster can spend fury points to return one destroyed small- or medium-based living Grunt from that unit to play for each fury point spent. A returned Grunt must be placed in the spellcaster’s control range and within 2" of another model in its unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box and must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions this turn.

cards.name: Return Fire
cards.text: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.

cards.name: Revive
cards.text: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model’s unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

cards.name: Rhythm of War
cards.text: Warjacks in this model's battlegroup that are in its control range can advance up to 3" after all friendly models have ended their activations on your turn.

cards.name: Rift
cards.text: Center a 3" template on the model directly hit. The template is rough terrain and remains in play for one round.

cards.name: Rites of Torment
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one horror in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3". A horror can advance only once per turn as a result of Rites of Torment.

cards.name: Ritual Sacrifice
cards.text: Remove target friendly warrior model from play. Skarre gains d6 additional focus points at the start of her next activation. Skarre can gain the benefit of Ritual Sacrifice only once per round.

cards.name: Road to War
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.

cards.name: Rock Wall
cards.text: Place a wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. The wall is an obstacle that provides cover. The wall is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

cards.name: Roots of the Earth
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains +3 ARM, cannot become knocked down, and cannot move or be placed. Roots of the Earth lasts for one round.

cards.name: Roth’s Mercy
cards.text: When an enemy attack disables a living model in the target friendly Faction unit, you can choose a non-disabled living model in the unit to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Roth’s Mercy, the disabled model removes 1 damage point.

cards.name: Rough Seas
cards.originLeader: Captain Rahera, Terror of the Wailing Sea
cards.text: When a friendly model in the spellcaster’s control range is targeted with a ranged attack, the attacking model rolls an additional die on its attack roll. Discard the highest die of each roll. Rough Seas lasts for one round.

cards.name: Sacrificial Lamb
cards.text: Remove one friendly Faction warrior model in the spellcaster’s control range from play. Each warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is currently in its control range gains 1 focus point. Sacrificial Lamb can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Sacrosanct
cards.text: When an enemy non-Leader warrior model destroys one or more friendly Faction models in the spellcaster’s control range with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model becomes knocked down. Sacrosanct lasts for one round.

cards.name: Sands of Fate
cards.text: Remove a friendly living Faction trooper model in the spellcaster’s control range from play and replace it with the spellcaster. The spellcaster cannot advance this activation after being placed by Sands of Fate.

cards.name: Scavenger’s Blessing
cards.text: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

cards.name: Scourge
cards.text: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack become knocked down.

cards.name: Scramble
cards.text: Target warjack suffers Disruption for one round.

cards.name: Scything Touch
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer – 2 ARM.)

cards.name: Sentry
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)

cards.name: Shadow Pack
cards.originLeader: Kapitan Galina Lissya, the Winter Fox
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth. Shadow Pack lasts for one round.

cards.name: Shadow Play
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Incorporeal this turn. During your Control Phase, the affected model gains Incorporeal for one turn.

cards.name: Shadow Step
cards.text: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer Shadow Bind for one round. Additionally, you can place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadow Step can be cast only once per activation. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.).

cards.name: Shadowmancer
cards.text: While in spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Stealth and Dark Shroud. Shadowmancer lasts for one round. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

cards.name: Shockwave
cards.text: On a direct hit, the model hit and other models within 2" of it become knocked down.

cards.name: Shrapnel Swarm
cards.text: On a direct hit, after resolving the damage roll, the model hit and models within 1" suffer 1 damage point.

cards.name: Sidekick
cards.text: Target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down or be pushed, placed, or moved by a slam. While B2B with target model, the spellcaster gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down or be pushed, placed, or moved by a slam.

cards.name: Signs & Portents
cards.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Signs & Portents lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Silence of Death
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Take Down. Models disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down are removed from play.)

cards.name: Siphon Bolt
cards.text: When this spell hits an enemy model with 1 or more focus or fury points on it, that model loses 1 focus or fury point and the spellcaster gains 1 focus point. Spellcasters without the Focus Manipulation special rule cannot gain focus as a result of Siphon Bolt.

cards.name: Skyborne
cards.text: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and DEF and Flight for one round.

cards.name: Slipstream
cards.text: When the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, choose one other large or smaller-based friendly Faction model within 2" of the spellcaster. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location, then Slipstream expires. A model can be placed as a result of Slipstream only once per turn. Slipstream lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Snipe
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model’s/unit’s ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

cards.name: Snow Shroud
cards.text: Friendly Faction models gain concealment while in the spellcaster’s control range. Snow Shroud lasts for one round.

cards.name: Solid Ground
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or be pushed and gain Resistance: Blast.

cards.name: Soothing Song
cards.originLeader: Calandra Truthsayer, Oracle of the Glimmerwood
cards.text: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently in the spellcaster’s control range. Soothing Song can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Soul Gate
cards.text: Remove a friendly trooper model in the spellcaster’s control range from play and replace it with target warjack in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. The warjack cannot activate this turn after being placed by Soul Gate.

cards.name: Soul Slave
cards.text: Target warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup automatically passes threshold checks. The spellcaster can channel spells through that warbeast.

cards.name: Soul Void
cards.text: When target friendly Faction model/unit destroys a living enemy model with a melee attack, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

cards.name: Soulfire
cards.text: When a living, non-soulless enemy model is boxed by Soulfire, the spellcaster gains 1 focus, fury, or essence point and the boxed model is removed from play. If the spellcaster does not have a special rule that allows it to gain focus, fury, or essence points, it cannot gain a focus, fury, or essence point as a result of Soulfire.

cards.name: Spectral Steel
cards.text: Target Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +2 ARM and Ghostly. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

cards.name: Spellpiercer
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, the weapons of friendly Faction models gain Blessed and Damage Type: Magical. Spellpiercer lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Spirit Door
cards.text: Choose a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. Immediately place that model completely within 2" of the spellcaster. If the chosen model is the spellcaster, immediately place it completely within 2" of another model in its battlegroup that was in its control range at the time the spell was cast. A model cannot advance or attack after being placed by Spirit Door this turn.

cards.name: Spirit Fang
cards.text: A model damaged by this attack suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

cards.name: Star-Crossed
cards.originLeader: Calandra Truthsayer, Oracle of the Glimmerwood
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, enemy models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the highest die of each roll. Star-Crossed lasts for one round.

cards.name: Stone Skin
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 melee attack damage rolls and +2 ARM but suffers –1 SPD and DEF.

cards.name: Storm Rager
cards.text: Target friendly Faction warrior model gains +2 MAT and ARM and +2 on melee attack damage rolls and cannot be targeted by combined ranged attacks or combined melee attacks.

cards.name: Stranglehold
cards.text: A model damaged by Stranglehold forfeits either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation, as its controller chooses.

cards.name: Strength of Granite
cards.text: Target model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup gains +4 to its melee attack damage rolls.

cards.name: Stygian Abyss
cards.text: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

cards.name: Sunburst
cards.originLeader: Constance Blaize, Knight of the Prophet
cards.text: Sunburst blast damage affects only enemy models. Models boxed by Sunburst are removed from play.

cards.name: Sunder Spirit
cards.text: An enemy warbeast damaged by Sunder Spirit loses its animus for one round.

cards.name: Sunhammer
cards.text: Enemy warbeasts and warjacks that advance more than 1" and end their Normal Movement in the spellcaster’s control range suffer d3 damage points.

cards.name: Superiority
cards.text: Target friendly Faction extra large-based or smaller warjack gains +2 SPD, MAT, and DEF and cannot become knocked down

cards.name: Sure Foot
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

cards.name: Synergy
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in this model’s battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on melee attack and melee damage rolls for each other model in the battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a melee attack this turn while in the spellcaster’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

cards.name: Tactical Supremacy
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

cards.name: Tantrum
cards.text: If one or more models in the spellcaster’s battlegroup were damaged by enemy attacks while within 5" of the spellcaster during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup in its control range can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack.

cards.name: Telekinesis
cards.text: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

cards.name: Teleport
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 6" of its current location, then its activation ends.

cards.name: Tempest
cards.text: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.

cards.name: Temporal Distortion
cards.text: This model gains +2 DEF. While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and enemy models suffer –2 DEF. Temporal Distortion lasts for one round.

cards.name: Tether
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: Immediately after the spellcaster ends its Normal Movement, target cohort in its battlegroup can advance up to 3" directly toward it.

cards.name: The Flesh Is Weak
cards.text: Living and undead models damaged by The Flesh Is Weak cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks for one round.

cards.name: The Lash
cards.text: When The Lash damages an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved this model or a friendly Faction model within 3" of it can advance up to 2". A model can advance only once per turn as a result of The Lash.

cards.name: Thunder Strike
cards.text: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by Thunder Strike is slammed d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 14 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14.

cards.name: Tide Pool
cards.text: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

cards.name: Tides of War
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

cards.name: Time Bomb
cards.text: A model directly hit by Time Bomb suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

cards.name: Torment
cards.text: When a model is damaged by Torment, for one round it loses Tough, cannot remove damage, and cannot transfer damage.

cards.name: Twisted Form
cards.text: Target enemy warbeast suffers –2 FURY, cannot have damage removed from it, and cannot have damage transferred to it. Twisted Form lasts for one round. Twisted Form can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Twister
cards.text: Center a cloud effect template on the model directly hit. The template remains in play for one round.

cards.name: Unminding
cards.text: Target enemy warbeast suffers –2 FURY and THR and loses its animus. The spellcaster can cast an affected warbeast’s animus.

cards.name: Unseen Path
cards.text: Unseen Path can be cast only while Scrapjack is in the Old Witch’s control range. Immediately place the Old Witch completely within 2" of Scrapjack or place Scrapjack completely within 2" of the Old Witch. A model cannot advance this turn after being placed by Unseen Path.

cards.name: Unstoppable Force
cards.text: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Bulldoze. Unstoppable Force lasts for one turn. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

cards.name: Vanish
cards.text: Place the spellcaster anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Vanish can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Veil of Mists
cards.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template does not block friendly Faction models’ LOS. While in the template, friendly Faction models gain Pathfinder and can move through obstructions and other models if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

cards.name: Velocity
cards.text: The spellcaster can spend up to 3 focus points to immediately advance up to 2" for each focus point spent. Velocity can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Vengeful
cards.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

cards.name: Venom
cards.text: Venom causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

cards.name: Vision
cards.text: When target friendly Faction model is directly hit by an attack, you can choose to have it suffer no damage roll from the attack, then Vision expires.

cards.name: Vortex of Destruction
cards.text: Damage rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s melee range are automatically boosted.

cards.name: Wall of Fire
cards.text: Place the wall template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range where it does not touch a model’s base, an obstruction, or an obstacle. When a model enters or ends its activation in the wall template, it suffers an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Models within the wall template gain concealment.

cards.name: Warpath
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster’s control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A Cohort model can advance as a result of Warpath only once per turn.

cards.name: Watcher
cards.text: Once per turn when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 6" of the spellcaster, you can choose a Cohort model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup that is in its control range. That Cohort model can immediately make a full advance toward the enemy model and then can make one basic attack targeting the enemy model.

cards.name: Watery Grave
cards.text: When a model is boxed by Watery Grave, center a 3" template on the boxed model and then remove that model from play. The template is shallow water terrain that remains in play for one round. While in the template models gain Resistance: Fire.

cards.name: Weald Secrets
cards.text: Target model/unit gains Pathfinder and Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

cards.name: White Squall
cards.text: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model hit by White Squall is thrown d6" directly away from the spell’s point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this throw is POW 12.

cards.name: Wild Aggression
cards.text: Target friendly living warbeast in the spellcaster’s battlegroup can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced and gains boosted melee attack rolls.

cards.name: Wind Rush
cards.text: The spellcaster can immediately make a full advance and gains +2 DEF for one round. Wind Rush can be cast only once per activation.

cards.name: Wind Wall
cards.text: The spellcaster cannot make ranged attacks after casting this spell, and non-magical ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss. While completely within 3" of the spellcaster, models cannot make ranged attacks and non-magical ranged attacks targeting them automatically miss. Wind Wall lasts for one round.

cards.name: Acrobatics
cards.text: This model can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. This model ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.

cards.name: Altered States
cards.text: At the start of your Maintenance Phase, choose a form for this model to take: Tharn Form or Beast Form. If it changes form, replace the model in play with its alternate form. Effects on the replaced model are applied to the alternate form. When one form replaces another, the new form is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering. You choose which form this model starts the game in.

cards.name: Anatomical Precision
cards.text: When this model’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

cards.name: Ancillary Attack (★ Action)
cards.text: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by an Ancillary Attack special action only once per turn.

cards.name: Arcane Calibrations
cards.text: Reduce the COST of each spell this model casts this activation by 1 to a minimum of 1.
