cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ begins the game with 7 focus points and a base ARC of 7. At the start of each of your turns, if _LEADER_NAME_ destroyed three or more enemy models with melee attacks during the last round, his base ARC becomes 7 for one round. The _LEADER_NAME_’s control range is measured from the Egregore. Any _LEADER_NAME_ model in the _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can spend focus points on the Egregore. Effects that reduce or remove focus never affect the Egregore. The _LEADER_NAME_ can use its feat only once. The _LEADER_NAME_ counts as a single warcaster when calculating Field Allowance. The _LEADER_NAME_ can have up to one attached model, which is attached to the _LEADER_NAME_, not to an individual model in the _LEADER_NAME_. The _LEADER_NAME_ can have only one of each of its upkeep spells in play at any time.

cards.name: Flesh Meld
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can use Flesh Meld at any time during her activation while B2B with Belphagor. Remove _LEADER_NAME_ from the table. Upkeep spells she cast do not immediately expire, and warbeasts in her battlegroup do not go wild. Any effects on _LEADER_NAME_ when she melds are applied to Belphagor. Remove the fury points currently on Belphagor. If there are any fury points on _LEADER_NAME_ when she melds, place them on Belphagor. Belphagor cannot activate later in a turn in which it becomes flesh melded. While melded, Belphagor becomes a warlock warrior model, loses Soulless, takes control of _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup, and can upkeep spells cast by _LEADER_NAME_. While melded, Belphagor loses its FURY and THR stats and gains AAT 7, ARC 7, and CTRL 14. While melded, Belphagor can cast _LEADER_NAME_’s spells and use her feat. While melded, Belphagor is not considered to be a warbeast and loses its animus. While melded, Belphagor suffers damage like a warbeast but does not suffer the effects of crippled aspects. Effects modifying the amount of damage to or the manner in which damage is applied to a warbeast still apply to Belphagor, even while it is melded. If Belphagor is destroyed or removed from play while melded, _LEADER_NAME_ is also destroyed. _LEADER_NAME_ can separate from Belphagor during your Maintenance Phase. When she returns to play, place her B2B with Belphagor. _LEADER_NAME_ returns to play with the same amount of damage she had when she was removed from the table as a result of Flesh Meld. After _LEADER_NAME_ returns to play, she can upkeep spells cast by Belphagor when they were melded.

cards.name: Wraith Walker
cards.text: At the end of your Control Phase, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round unless it gained Incorporeal during the last round.

cards.name: Wraithbinder
cards.text: While within 10" of this model, friendly Incorporeal models gain +3 ARM.

cards.name: z_50mm
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness

cards.name: •Blood Rage
cards.text: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

cards.name: •Death Feast
cards.text: During its activation, this model can spend corpse tokens to remove d3 damage points for each token spent.

cards.name: •Meat for the Beast
cards.text: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

cards.name: •Repair [d3 +1] (★Action)
cards.text: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

cards.name: Adrenaline Rush
cards.text: Monstrosities in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain +3 SPD and ARM and +3 to their melee attack damage rolls for one round.

cards.name: Air Support
cards.text: Put a Rocketman unit and a Rocketman Ace solo into play. Place each model completely within 3" of _LEADER_NAME_.

cards.name: Arcane Alignment
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 RNG to their non-channeled spells, and their arcane attack rolls and arcane attack damage rolls are boosted. Arcane Alignment lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Arcane Conflagration
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range friendly Gun Mage and friendly Faction warjack models' ranged weapons gain Blessed, Damage Type: Magical, and +2 POW. When a friendly Faction model makes an attack with a weapon with Attack Types while in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, that model can choose two special rules instead of one. Arcane Conflagration lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Arcane Convergence
cards.text: Each friendly Faction model currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can immediately cast one spell without spending focus, performing a special action, or performing a special attack.

cards.name: Arcane Reaver
cards.text: Immediately remove any number of soul tokens, fury points, essence points, and focus points from non-Leader models in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range. For each token or point removed, place 1 fury point on _LEADER_NAME_. _LEADER_NAME_ cannot exceed his current ARC in fury points as a result of Arcane Reaver.

cards.name: Arcane Singularity
cards.text: Friendly _LEADER_NAME_ models in play currently in this model’s control range gain +2 AAT, ARC, and Ctrl for one turn and immediately gain 2 focus points.

cards.name: Arcanodynamic Catalysis
cards.text: Enemy upkeep spells and animi in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range immediately expire. For one round, when an enemy model is forced, casts a spell, or spends 1 or more essence, focus, or fury points while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, you can place one catalytic token on a model in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in her control range. If a model casts a spell by spending essence, focus, or fury, Arcanodynamic Catalysis triggers only once. A model cannot have more than three catalytic tokens on it at any time. A model gains +1 DEF and +1 ARM for each catalytic token on it. The weapons of a model with one or more catalytic tokens gain Damage Type: Magical. Remove one catalytic token from each affected model at the end of its activation.

cards.name: Arcantrik Aptitude
cards.text: Remove all damage from extra-large and smaller based models in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in her control range. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM and friendly Faction warjacks models do not suffer the effects of crippled systems. Arcantrik Aptitude lasts for one round.

cards.name: Avalanche of Steel
cards.text: Friendly faction warrior models within _LEADER_NAME_'s control range gain a +2 bonus to melee attack rolls. Additionally, when a friendly faction model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with an attack while in his control range, after the attack is resolved, one friendly faction warrior model within his control range can immediately advance up to 2" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only advance and attack as a result of Avalanche of Steel once per game. Avalanche of Steel lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Barroom Blitz
cards.text: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge, slam power attack, or trample power attack in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range gain +2 SPD. Warbeasts in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range can make power attacks without being forced and gain an additional die on collateral damage and power attack damage rolls. Barroom Blitz lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Bastion of Faith
cards.originLeader: Anson Durst, Rock of the Faith
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, warjacks in his battlegroup gain +4 ARM. When a friendly Faction warrior model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range is directly hit by an attack while B2B with a warjack in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup, you can choose to have the warjack be directly hit instead. The warjack is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects from the attack. Bastion of Faith lasts for one round.

cards.name: Black Gate
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted magic attack rolls. When _LEADER_NAME_ casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When an enemy model casts a spell while in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, increase the COST by 1. Black Gate lasts for one round.

cards.name: Black Roots
cards.text: The area within 10" of _LEADER_NAME_ becomes a forest. Enemy models that become knocked down while within 10" of _LEADER_NAME_ suffer 1 damage point. Black Roots lasts for one round.

cards.name: Black Tide
cards.text: Enemy models without Amphibious currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range become knocked down.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.text: Enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range and LOS suffer Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

cards.name: Blades of Vengeance
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in his control range gain +2 SPD. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Duelist. Blades of Vengeance lasts for one round.

cards.name: Blessings of the Void
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and ARM and friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 DEF and ARM. Blessings of the Void lasts for one round.

cards.name: Blitz
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in her control range can make one additional ranged or melee attack during their activations. Blitz lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Blood Frenzy
cards.originLeader: Orsus Zoktavir, The Butcher of Khardov
cards.text: While in the Butcher’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack damage rolls this turn.

cards.name: Blood Legacy
cards.text: Choose d3 + 3 friendly Faction non-character warrior models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Those models gain +3 SPD, MAT, RAT, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, affected models gain +3 to their melee attack damage rolls. Blood Legacy lasts for one round.

cards.name: Blood Magic
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately suffers any number of damage points. For each damage point suffered as a result of Blood Magic, one friendly Faction model currently in her control range gains +5 ARM and +5 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round. This model cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.

cards.name: Blood Moon
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model directly hits a model in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range with an attack, resolve the attack as if it was a critical hit. Blood Moon lasts for one round.

cards.name: Blood of Dhunia
cards.text: While within _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain an additional die on melee attack rolls. When a model in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup that is in his control range is hit by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3 + 3 damage points from the model. Blood of Dhunia lasts for one round.

cards.name: Blood Rage
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ suffers up to 7 damage points. For each damage point he suffers, _LEADER_NAME_ gains 1 fury point. _LEADER_NAME_’s fury point total cannot exceed his current ARC as a result of Blood Rage. If _LEADER_NAME_ is in Tharn form when this feat is used, he can immediately take beast form; replace his Tharn form model with his beast form model. Effects on the replaced model are applied to the beast model.

cards.name: Blood Rites
cards.originLeader: Skarre, Admiral of the Black Fleet
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can suffer 1 damage point to cast a spell instead of spending focus this activation. She can cast each of her spells once as a result of Blood Rites.

cards.name: Blood Sacrifice
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately suffers 1 or more damage points. This damage cannot be transferred. For each damage point she suffers, return one destroyed non-character living friendly Faction trooper model to play. Returned models must be placed completely within her control range and within 2" of another model in their units. Troopers are returned with one unmarked damage box and must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions this turn.

cards.name: Bloodletting
cards.originLeader: Captain Rahera, Terror of the Wailing Sea
cards.text: Model in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in her control range and friendly living warrior models currently in her control range can immediately make one basic melee or ranged attack. These attacks must target enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range warbeast in his battlegroup can charge and make slam power attacks without being forced. Additionally, when a model in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup declares a charge or slam power attack while in his control range, that model gains +3 SPD that activation. Bloodlust lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Bombs Away
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 RAT. When an enemy model suffers a blast damage roll or is directly hit by an AOE weapon while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, add an additional die to the damage roll. Bombs Away lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Boneyard
cards.text: Large and smaller-based models in _LEADER_NAME_' battlegroup currently in his control range gain Dig In. An affected model that begins its activation dug in as a result of Boneyard gains +2 SPD and a focus point that activation. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

cards.name: Breach
cards.text: Remove all wall templates currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Additionally, the next time each enemy model suffers a damage roll while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, halve its base ARM when calculating damage. Breach lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Broken Earth
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain cover. While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models never have Pathfinder and treat open terrain as rough terrain. Broken Earth lasts for one round.

cards.name: Burnt Out
cards.text: Enemy models currently within 3" of of one or more warjacks in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in her control range suffer an unboostable POW 13 fire damage roll and the fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Call of the Hunt
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can force warbeasts in her battlegroup even if they are outside her control range. At the end of the activation of each warbeast in her battlegroup, you can place that warbeast anywhere completely within 3" of _LEADER_NAME_. Call of the Hunt lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Call of Valor
cards.originLeader: Grissel Bloodsong, Marshal of the Kriels
cards.text: Friendly Faction models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range gain Reposition [3"] and Unyielding. Call of Valor lasts for one round. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.) (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

cards.name: Cat & Mouse
cards.text: At the end of this turn after all friendly models have ended their activations, each friendly non-trooper Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can make a full advance.

cards.name: Charge of the Horse Lords
cards.originLeader: Vladimir Tzepesci, Great Prince of Umbrey
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction warjacks and cavalry models gain Side Step and Sprint. Charge of the Horse Lords lasts for one turn. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.) (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

cards.name: Checkmate
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can use his Battle Plan ability a total of three times this activation. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models ignore cover and concealment when making ranged attacks this turn.

cards.name: Circumpotence
cards.text: Enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range suffer –2 SPD, –2 to their melee damage rolls, and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Friendly Faction models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range gain +2 SPD and +2 to their melee damage rolls. Circumpotence lasts for one round.

cards.name: Clash of Flames
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately casts Incite without spending focus. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Flame Trail. Clash of Flames lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Clockwork Reinforcement
cards.text: While within _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +4 ARM. When a friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range makes a Repair special action, add +2 to the damage removed. Clockwork Reinforcement lasts for one round.

cards.name: Closing Darkness
cards.text: Friendly models/units currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range gain Ghostly and are affected by Boundless Charge. Closing Darkness lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

cards.name: Cloud Burst
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ gains the benefit of all of his Arcane Machinery effects this activation. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly models can reroll Stormcall attack and attack damage rolls. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Cloud Burst. Cloud Burst lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Conjoined Spirits
cards.text: Conjoined Spirits can be used once per game by either _LEADER_NAME_ or Rhyas. When it is used, you can either have _LEADER_NAME_ and Rhyas immediately trade places or you can return one of them to play. If you choose to return _LEADER_NAME_ or Rhyas to play, place the returned model completely within 3" of the model that used Conjoined Spirits. The returned model comes into play with a number of fury points equal to its ARC. After Conjoined Spirits is used, _LEADER_NAME_ and Rhyas cannot advance for the rest of the turn. If you return _LEADER_NAME_ to play as a result of Conjoined Spirits, Rhyas is no longer a warlock or a Leader model and returns to being a solo.

cards.name: Conquest
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM, +3 to their melee attack damage rolls, and can move or be moved only during your turn. Conquest lasts for one round.

cards.name: Consuming Blight
cards.text: Enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range suffer an unboostable POW 5 damage roll. Consuming Blight damage rolls are simultaneous. _LEADER_NAME_ then gains up to 7 focus points. He cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Consuming Blight.

cards.name: Dance of Death
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately casts Incite without spending fury. Additionally, when a model in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models in her control range with an attack, either _LEADER_NAME_ can gain 1 fury point or 1 fury point can be removed from a model in her battlegroup that is in her control range. Dance of Death lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Dark Dominion
cards.text: When a living or undead enemy warrior model is boxed by an attack while in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, you can take control of it. The model becomes an independent model and gains Undead. The model can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack, then remove the model from play. Dark Dominion lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Dark Miracles
cards.text: This activation, _LEADER_NAME_ can cast each of her spells once without spending fury.

cards.name: Dark Omen
cards.text: Enemy models roll one fewer die when making attack and damage rolls while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Dark Omen lasts for one round.

cards.name: Dark Revival
cards.text: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller warbeast that was part of _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup to play. Place it anywhere completely within 3" of him. The warbeast must forfeit its Combat Action this turn.

cards.name: Dark Summons
cards.text: Put a small-based Bane unit into play. Place each model completely within 3" of _LEADER_NAME_.

cards.name: Dark Waters
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot be targeted by attacks, charges, or slam power attacks made by models more than 5" away from them. Dark Waters lasts for one round.

cards.name: Darkest Night
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately casts Fog of War without spending fury. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range destroys an enemy model with a melee attack during its activation, another friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance only once as a result of Darkest Night. Darkest Night lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Dawn’s Light
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain True Sight and gain one additional die on attack and damage rolls. For each of those rolls, discard one die of your choice. Dawn’s Light lasts for one turn. (A model with True Sight ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. A model with True Sight also ignores Stealth.)

cards.name: Dead of Night
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, friendly models gain Stealth, Reposition [3"], and Take Down. While in his control range, enemy models' ranged weapons suffer –4 RNG. Dead of Night lasts for one round.

cards.name: Dead of Winter
cards.text: Place d3+3 cloud effect templates anywhere completely in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. These templates are hazards that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Cold suffers 1 point of cold damage for each Dead of Winter template it enters or ends its activation within.

cards.name: Dead on Arrival
cards.text: Enemy non-Leader models in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range are immediately pushed 3" directly toward _LEADER_NAME_ in the order you choose. Then enemy models within 3" of _LEADER_NAME_ suffer a POW 12 magical damage roll. These damage rolls are simultaneous. For each model destroyed by Dead on Arrival, you can allocate 1 focus point to a warjack in _LEADER_NAME_’ battlegroup in his control range.

cards.name: Death Harvest
cards.text: Each time a friendly Faction model destroys an enemy model while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, _LEADER_NAME_ gains 1 fury point. Immediately after resolving an attack in which a friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range destroyed one or more enemy models, _LEADER_NAME_ can cast one spell. _LEADER_NAME_ can spend fury points to boost attack and damage rolls on spells cast as a result of Death Harvest. Death Harvest lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Death Ritual
cards.text: Immediately remove from play one or more friendly living or undead models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range. For each model removed, _LEADER_NAME_ can gain one corpse token or one fury point or can remove d3 damage points from a model in his battlegroup. _LEADER_NAME_ cannot exceed his ARC in fury points as a result of Death Ritual.

cards.name: Death Wind
cards.text: Friendly Faction warrior models beginning their activations in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range gain Acrobatics, Overtake, and Unstoppable. Death Wind lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Decimation
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models' ranged weapons gain Pistol and affected models can make one additional ranged attack during their activations. Decimation lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Defiance of the Void
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly living models gain Retaliatory Strike. Additionally, when a friendly living warrior model in this model’s control range is disabled, this model can suffer 1 damage point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model. This damage cannot be transferred. Defiance of the Void lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

cards.name: Desperate Ground
cards.text: Friendly Faction models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range ignore cloud effects and forests when determining LOS and gain Pathfinder. Affected models currently knocked down immediately stand up. Enemy models/units beginning their activations in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer –3 SPD. Desperate Ground lasts for one round.

cards.name: Desperate Hour
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly non-Leader Faction models gain Berserk and Overtake. Desperate Hour lasts for one turn. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

cards.name: Dhunia’s Wrath
cards.originLeader: Hoarluk Doomshaper, Shaman of the Gnarls
cards.text: Enemy models suffer d6 damage points for each focus or fury point they spend while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Enemy warbeasts suffer d6 damage points for each fury point they receive as a result of being forced while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. If a model is destroyed as a result of this damage while casting a spell, the spell does not take effect. If a model is destroyed as a result of this damage while making an attack, the target model suffers no further damage or effects from the attack. Dhunia’s Wrath lasts for one round.

cards.name: Disjunction
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models cannot leech fury, enemy warbeasts cannot have fury leeched from them, and enemy warjacks cannot power up. Disjunction lasts for one round.

cards.name: Divine Intervention
cards.originLeader: Constance Blaize, Knight of the Prophet
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly living warrior models gain +1 ARM for each soul token on _LEADER_NAME_. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, Morrowan models gain Divine Inspiration. Divine Intervention lasts for one round. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

cards.name: Divine Might
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells and enemy Leaders suffer –2 ARC. Divine Might lasts for one round.

cards.name: Divine Protection
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, friendly Faction warrior models cannot be targeted by charges, slam power attacks, enemy spells, or non-magical ranged attacks. Divine Protection lasts for one round.

cards.name: Doom's Day
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately gains five soul tokens. When a model in _LEADER_NAME_' control range makes an attack or damage roll, _LEADER_NAME_ can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Doom's Day. Doom's Day lasts for one round.

cards.name: Dragon Storm
cards.text: After all friendly models have completed their activations this turn, each warbeast in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup that is in his control range can make a full advance followed by one basic melee attack. Completely resolve each warbeast’s movement and attack before moving on to the next.

cards.name: Dragon's Breath
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_' control range, enemy models lose Resistance: Fire and cannot gain it. Additionally, enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range immediately suffer the fire continuous effect. Dragon's Breath lasts for one round.

cards.name: Dragon’s Call
cards.text: When a living enemy model is destroyed in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, _LEADER_NAME_ gains the destroyed model’s soul token. _LEADER_NAME_ gains +1 ARM for each soul token on him. Dragon’s Call lasts for one round.

cards.name: Electrical Storm
cards.text: Enemy Cohort models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer a POW 14 electrical damage roll. Electrical Storm damage rolls are simultaneous. Warjacks damaged by Electrical Storm suffer Disruption.

cards.name: Eleventh Hour
cards.text: Friendly Faction models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range gain Reposition [5"] and Unstoppable. Eleventh Hour lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

cards.name: Essence of Dust
cards.text: Friendly Faction models currently in the Testament’s control range gain Incorporeal. When declaring charges and slam power attacks or when making attacks, friendly Faction models can ignore models in the Testament’s control range when determining LOS. Essence of Dust lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Exhortation of Martyrdom
cards.originLeader: Bohdan Lesnoi, Apostle of the Witch
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain Last Word. Additionally, _LEADER_NAME_ gains Grim Salvation. Exhortation of Martyrdom lasts for one round. (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.) (If a model with Grim Salvation is directly hit by a basic attack made by an enemy model, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of the model with Grim Salvation to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.)

cards.name: Eye of the Storm
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model makes an electrical damage roll against an enemy model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, add an additional die to the damage roll. Eye of the Storm lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Fate Weaver
cards.originLeader: Skarre, Queen of the Broken Coast
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately suffers up to 5 damage points. Skarrel cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage. For each damage point she suffers as a result of Fate Weaver, one model currently in her control range can be affected by Fate Weaver. An affected friendly model cannot be targeted by charges and gains +5 DEF for one round. An affected enemy model suffers –5 to attack rolls for one round.

cards.name: Feat: Vigilance of the Faithful
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. When one or more friendly Faction models are destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved one friendly Faction warrior model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can advance up to 3". A model can only move once per turn as a result of Vigilance of the Faithful. Vigilance of the Faithful lasts for one round.

cards.name: Feel the Hate
cards.text: Each time an enemy model is destroyed in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, you can place one rage token on a friendly Faction model in his control range. A model can have up to three rage tokens at any time. Models can spend rage tokens during their activations to make additional melee attacks or to boost melee attack or melee damage rolls. A model can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent. Feel the Hate lasts for one turn. Remove unspent rage tokens at the end of this turn.

cards.name: Fell Chorus
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can use her Battle Plans three times this activation. Additionally, Desperate Pace, Money Shot, and Tenacity become RNG 12 this activation.

cards.name: Field of Bones
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain Dark Shroud and their melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Field of Bones lasts for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.) (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

cards.name: Field of Slaughter

cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Electricity and Unstoppable. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap. Powerhouse lasts for one round.

cards.name: Prayers of War
cards.text: Warjacks in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain 1 focus point. _LEADER_NAME_ gains 1 focus point for each warjack in his battlegroup currently in his control range. _LEADER_NAME_ cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Prayers of War.

cards.name: Psychic Apocalypse
cards.text: Enemy warbeasts currently in Sturm & _LEADER_NAME_’s control range have their base FURY reduced to 1. Enemy warjacks currently in Sturm & _LEADER_NAME_’s control range cannot be allocated focus. Horrors cannot be summoned in Sturm & _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. While in Sturm & _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models cannot be used to channel spells. Psychic Apocalypse lasts for one round.

cards.name: Purge the Faithless
cards.text: When an enemy model is boxed by a melee or ranged attack while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models within 2" of the boxed models suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll. After resolving this damage, the boxed model is removed from play. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Purge the Faithless lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Rage of Ancients
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ gains a number of ancestral rage tokens equal to the number of friendly Faction warrior models that have been destroyed and not returned to play since the start of the game. While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models can spend ancestral rage tokens on _LEADER_NAME_ to boost one melee attack or melee damage roll for each token spent. At the end of the turn, remove unspent ancestral rage tokens from _LEADER_NAME_.

cards.name: Rage of the Dragon
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 to their melee attack damage rolls and their melee weapons gain the Fire continuous effect. Rage of the Dragon lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Raging Inferno
cards.text: When an enemy model suffers a fire damage roll while in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, add an additional die to the damage roll. Raging Inferno lasts for one round.

cards.name: Rallying Cry
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models cannot become knocked down. When a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, that model can remove 1 damage point. After removing this damage the affected model can advance up to 3". Rallying Cry lasts for one round.

cards.name: Reanimator
cards.text: Remove one or more friendly Faction warrior models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range from play. For each model removed, return one destroyed non-character friendly Faction warrior model to play completely within _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Place returned troopers models in play within 2" of another model in their units. Returned models forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they return to play.

cards.name: Reap the Whirlwind
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on ranged attack and ranged damage rolls for each other model in his battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this turn while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3. Reap the Whirlwind lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Recalibration
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models can reroll attack and damage rolls this turn. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Recalibration.

cards.name: Red Haze
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately gains 6 focus points. He cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Red Haze. Living enemy models cannot charge _LEADER_NAME_. Red Haze lasts for one round.

cards.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
cards.text: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller Cohort model that was part of _LEADER_NAME_'s battlegroup to play. Place it anywhere completely within 3" of her. The Cohort model must forfeit its Combat Action this turn.

cards.name: Restorations of Shadow
cards.text: Remove all damage from friendly Faction extra-large and smaller based models in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Additionally, each warjack in _LEADER_NAME_'s battlegroup currently in his control range gains 1 focus point.

cards.name: Resurrection
cards.text: Return d3 + 5 friendly destroyed Faction troopers to play. Place those models within 2" of another model in their unit and completely within the High _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Returned models must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

cards.name: Ride the Storm
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. Additionally, while in her control range models in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup gain Dodge and Riposte. (When a model with Riposte is missed by an enemy melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the model with Riposte can make one basic melee attack against the attacking model.)

cards.name: Rising Tide
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately casts Manifest Destiny without spending focus. Additionally, models in _LEADER_NAME_’ battlegroup that are currently in his control range gain +3 SPD for one turn.

cards.name: Rites of Shadow
cards.text: When an enemy model is forced, casts a spell, or spends 1 or more focus or fury points while in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, _LEADER_NAME_ can remove d3 damage points and gains one soul token. If a model casts a spell by spending focus or fury, Rites of Shadow triggers only once. Rites of Shadow lasts for one round.

cards.name: Rites of the Wurm
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can channel spells through warbeasts in her battlegroup while they are in her control range. Additionally, when _LEADER_NAME_ or a warbeast in her battlegroup in her control range casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When _LEADER_NAME_ casts a spell affected by Rites of the Wurm, the COST of a spell cannot be reduced to less than 1. Rites of the Wurm lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Rolling Fog
cards.originLeader: Jarl Skuld, Devil of the Thornwood
cards.text: Place d3 + 3 cloud effect templates anywhere completely within _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Rolling Fog templates do not block friendly Faction models’ LOS. Friendly Faction models can advance through other friendly Faction models that are in a Rolling Fog template if they have enough movement to move completely past them. While in one or more Rolling Fog templates, living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls. Rolling Fog lasts for one round.

cards.name: Rolling Thunder
cards.text: After all friendly models have completed their activations this turn, friendly Faction models/units currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can advance up to 3" and then can make one basic melee attack. When resolving these attacks, affected models can spend focus points to boost one attack or damage roll for each focus point spent.

cards.name: Rough House
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and Rapid Healing. Rough House lasts for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

cards.name: Roulette
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, models gain two additional dice on their attack rolls. For each of those attack rolls, you choose two of the dice rolled to be discarded. Roulette lasts for one round.

cards.name: Rum & Grapeshot
cards.text: Friendly warrior models with Stumbling Drunk gain +3 ARM. When a friendly model is pushed as a result of Stumbling Drunk you can choose the direction it is pushed. Rum & Grapeshot lasts for one round.

cards.name: Scorched Earth
cards.text: Enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer the Fire continuous effect. Friendly warjack models can charge or power attack slam enemy models suffering the fire continuous effect without spending a focus point. Scorched Earth lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Scorpion’s Sting
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 MAT and +2 to their melee attack damage rolls and Defensive Strike. Scorpion’s Sting lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement, or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

cards.name: Scroll of Grimmr
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ and friendly Faction warbeasts in his battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range gain +3 SPD and can charge or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced. Scroll of Grimmr lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Seeds of Destruction
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model boxes a living or undead enemy model with a melee or ranged attack while the enemy model is in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range this turn, enemy models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 13 damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Friendly models within 2" of the boxed model can each remove d3 damage points. Then the destroyed model is removed from play.

cards.name: Shadow Initiative
cards.text: Upkeep spells in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range immediately expire. This activation _LEADER_NAME_ can cast one spell without spending focus for each upkeep spell that expired as a result of Shadow Initiative.

cards.name: Shadow War
cards.text: When one or more enemy model are destroyed by an attack while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in its control range gains 1 focus point. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, models in his battle group gain Stealth. Shadow War lasts for one round.

cards.name: Shadowfall
cards.text: Models in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in her control range are affected by Ghost Walk. Additionally, you can place each friendly faction Cohort model currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadowfall lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Shadows of Annihilation
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ immediately casts Locked Horns without spending essence. Additionally, _LEADER_NAME_ and friendly Faction models activating in his control range gain +2 SPD and Ghostly. Shadows of Annihilation lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

cards.name: Shadows of Urcaen
cards.text: Immediately place _LEADER_NAME_ anywhere completely within 2" of her current location. When a friendly Faction model activates in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, at the start of its activation you can place it anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. Shadows of Urcaen lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Shock & Awe
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, friendly Faction models can reroll their attack and damage rolls. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Shock & Awe. Shock & Awe lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Snowblind
cards.text: Enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range lose and cannot gain Eyeless Sight, Flight, or Pathfinder and cannot make ranged attacks for one round. Additionally, enemy models in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range are pushed 2" directly away from _LEADER_NAME_ in the order you choose.

cards.name: Spectral Legion
cards.text: Return up to d3 + 5 friendly destroyed small- or medium-based Grunts to play. Place these models anywhere completely within 3" of _LEADER_NAME_. Returned models gain Undead and Ghostly and become solos. These returned models cannot be targeted by attacks or damaged. Returned models leave play at the end of this turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

cards.name: Spirit Realm
cards.text: Friendly Bullcroak models currently in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range gain Incorporeal for one round. Additionally, for one round when another model casts a spell while in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, _LEADER_NAME_ gains a fury point or can remove d3 damage from a model in his battlegroup.

cards.name: Spirit World
cards.text: Friendly Faction models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range gain Incorporeal this turn. While within _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction undead models gain +2 ARM. Spirit World lasts for one round.

cards.name: Spread the Net
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models suffer –3 DEF. Enemy models beginning their activations in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer –3 SPD and cannot charge or make power attacks or special attacks. Spread the Net lasts for one round.

cards.name: Stand & Deliver
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM, +3 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Set Defense. Stand & Deliver lasts for one round. (Models suffer –2 on charge, slam power attack, and impact attack rolls against a model with Set Defense.)

cards.name: Standing Tall
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_' control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM, Resistance: Blast, and cannot become knocked down. Standing Tall lasts for one round.

cards.name: Starstrike Calibration
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ and friendly Faction models with Flight beginning their activations in her control range gain +2 SPD. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model with Flight makes an attack against an enemy model without Flight while the enemy model is in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, the friendly model gains +2 to its damage rolls resulting from that attack. Starstrike Calibration lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Stoking the Flames
cards.text: Friendly Faction models gain boosted attack and damage rolls against enemy models in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffering the Fire continuous effect. Stoking the Flames lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Stone’s Fortitude
cards.text: When an enemy model makes a damage roll against a friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, the enemy model rolls one less die. Stone’s Fortitude lasts for one round.

cards.name: Storm of Ages
cards.text: Enemy models/units activating in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer –2 SPD, cannot charge, and cannot make slam or trample power attacks. When a friendly model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range is targeted by a ranged or arcane attack, the attack suffers –2 RNG. Storm of Ages lasts for one round.

cards.name: Storm Ravager
cards.text: Place three 3" templates anywhere completely within _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. These templates are hazards. Enemy models in one or more of the templates when they are placed suffer a boostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. An enemy model entering or ending its activation in one or more of the templates suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. During each of your Maintenance Phases, remove one AOE.

cards.name: Strength Eternal
cards.text: Remove d6 + 3 damage points from each friendly Faction construct model currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction construct models gain +3 ARM. Strength Eternal lasts for one round.

cards.name: Strength of Arms
cards.text: When a friendly Faction model makes a melee attack against an enemy model while the enemy model is in _LEADER_NAME_' control range, the attack automatically hits. While in _LEADER_NAME_' control range, friendly Faction models can make one additional melee attack during their Combat Actions. Strength of Arms lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Symbiosis
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain Flank [friendly Faction warbeast]. Symbiosis lasts for one round. (When a model with Flank [friendly Faction warbeast] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction warbeast model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional die on damage rolls.)

cards.name: Technological Superiority
cards.text: Warjacks in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range can charge without spending focus and gain an additional die on their attack rolls. Technological Superiority lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Telekinetic Tide
cards.text: Push each enemy non-Leader model currently in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range 2" in any direction.

cards.name: Temporal Barrier
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, enemy models suffer –2 DEF. Enemy models beginning their activations in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer –2 SPD. Temporal Barrier lasts for one round.

cards.name: The Dark Silence
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_' control range, friendly models gain concealment and Dodge. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_' control range, friendly models cannot be targeted by charges or slam power attacks. The Dark Silence lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

cards.name: The Reaping
cards.text: When an enemy model is directly hit by a ranged attack made by a friendly Faction model while the friendly Faction model is in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round. The Reaping lasts for one turn.

cards.name: The Vanishing
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Stealth and cannot be targeted by charges or slam power attacks. The Vanishing lasts for one round.

cards.name: The Withering
cards.text: Enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range suffer –2 SPD, MAT, RAT, DEF, and ARM. The Withering lasts for one round.

cards.name: Thundering Rage
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models’ weapons gain +2 POW and Beat Back. Thundering Rage lasts for one turn. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.)

cards.name: Tide of Blood
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ and friendly Faction models activating in her control range gain one additional melee attack during their Combat Actions. The first time a friendly Faction model damages an enemy model with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action while in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, immediately place the attacking model anywhere B2B with the damaged model. Tide of Blood lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Tide of Earth
cards.text: Choose a table edge and a distance up to 5". Models in Thorle’s battlegroup that are in his control range are pushed the chosen distance directly toward the chosen table edge in the order you choose. At the end of your turn, choose a distance up to 5". Models in Thorle’s battlegroup that are in his control range are pushed the chosen distance directly away from the chosen table edge in the order you choose.

cards.name: Tides of Battle
cards.text: When one or more friendly Faction models are destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack while in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range at any time except while advancing, immediately after the attack is resolved one friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range can advance up to 3". Tide of Battle lasts for one round.

cards.name: Time of the Beast
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Tharn models gain +2 ARM and +2 to their attack damage rolls. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Time of the Beast. Time of the Beast lasts for one round.

cards.name: To the Slaughter
cards.text: This model gains +2 SPD. When a model in this model's batltegroup activates while in this model's control range, the activating model gains +2 SPD. When an affected model ends its Normal Movement with an enemy model in its melee range, the affected model gains 1 focus point. To the Slaughter lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Total Annihilation
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their melee damage rolls. While in _LEADER_NAME_’ control range and B2B with another friendly Faction model, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM. Total Annihilation lasts for one round.

cards.name: Troubleshoot
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range, friendly Faction models can reroll ranged attack and ranged attack damage rolls. Additionally, affected models' ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Troubleshoot. Troubleshoot lasts for one turn.

cards.name: True Grit
cards.text: Choose d6 + 5 friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Chosen models gain +2 ARM. When a chosen model is disabled, it removes 1 damage point and becomes knocked down. True Grit lasts for one round.

cards.name: Typhoon
cards.text: Enemy models that andvance and end their movement in or are placed in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range become knocked down. While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls. Typhoon lasts for one round.

cards.name: Undying Loyalty
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 to attack rolls and Tough and cannot become knocked down. When a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, remove 1 damage point from that model. Undying Loyalty lasts for one round.

cards.name: Unearthly Rage
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain boosted melee damage rolls and their melee weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Unearthly Rage lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Union
cards.text: Each warjack in Amon’s battlegroup currently in his control range immediately gains 1 focus point.

cards.name: Unstoppable Tide
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 DEF and Dodge. Unstoppable Tide lasts for one round.

cards.name: Vengeance of the Dragonfather
cards.text: Enemy models cannot allocate focus points to or leech fury points from models in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Vengeance of the Dragonfather lasts for one round.

cards.name: Vengeful Spirits
cards.text: Choose up to d3 + 5 enemy models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Remove from play one friendly Faction warrior model within 5" of each chosen enemy model. Each chosen enemy model suffers a magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the corresponding removed model. Models destroyed by Vengeful Spirits are removed from play.

cards.name: Void Wind
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 DEF and Poltergeist. Void Wind lasts for one round.

cards.name: Vortex Lock
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range enemy models cannot cast spells, summon horrors, channel spells, or spend focus or fury points. Vortex Lock last for one round.

cards.name: Wall of Fangs
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Defensive Strike and Reposition [3"]. Wall of Fangs lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.) (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

cards.name: Weathering the Storm
cards.text: While in di _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly models gain one additional dice on their attack rolls. When resolving a friendly model’s roll, discard the lowest die rolled. While in di _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models gain one additional dice on their attack rolls and damage rolls. When resolving an enemy model’s roll, discard the highest die rolled. Weathering the Storm lasts for one round.

cards.name: Web of Shadows
cards.text: Choose d3 + 3 friendly non-Leader Faction models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. The chosen models gain Incorporeal for one round.

cards.name: Well of Sorrow
cards.originLeader: Agathon, The Voice in the Darkness
cards.text: When an enemy model casts a spell while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, models gain one additional die on their arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. You choose a die to discard in each roll. Well of Sorrow lasts for one round.

cards.name: Whispering Void
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 DEF. When an enemy model misses a friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place the friendly model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Whispering Void lasts for one round.

cards.name: Whispers of the Veld
cards.text: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold destroys or removes from play one or more friendly models in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range with a melee attack, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round after the attack is resolved. Additionally, when a friendly living Faction warrior model is destroyed by an enemy attack while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, _LEADER_NAME_ gains the destroyed model’s soul token. When _LEADER_NAME_ replenishes his focus during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token on him with 1 focus point, then Whispers of the Veld expires.

cards.name: Whispers of Torment
cards.text: While in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, enemy models suffer –3 MAT, RAT, and THR. Additionally, affected models suffer –3 to their melee attack damage rolls. Whispers of Torment lasts for one round.

cards.name: Wild Mastery
cards.text: Place any number of fury points on each friendly Faction warbeast in _LEADER_NAME_’s battlegroup currently in her control range. She can immediately leech fury points from warbeasts in her battlegroup that are in her control range.

cards.name: Wildfire
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ gains 1 focus point for each enemy model currently in her control range suffering the Fire continuous effect and can immediately give that focus to warjacks in her battlegroup that are in her control range. _LEADER_NAME_ can then remove the Fire continuous effects from any number of models in her control range. For each Fire continuous effect _LEADER_NAME_ removes, choose one model in her control range to suffer the Fire continuous effect.

cards.name: Winds of Change
cards.text: Enemy models currently within _LEADER_NAME_'s control range suffer -2 RAT for one round and may be pushed 2" directly away from this model in the order you choose. Enemy models activating in _LEADER_NAME_'s control range lose Flight for one turn. Winds of Change Lasts for one round.

cards.name: Winter’s Chill
cards.text: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold suffers a damage roll while in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, double the damage that exceeds the model’s ARM. Winter’s Chill lasts for one turn.

cards.name: Winter’s Grasp
cards.text: Choose any number of friendly Faction small- or medium-based non-Leader warrior models currently in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range. Enemy models within 1" of a chosen model become stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold, then the chosen models are destroyed.

cards.name: Wrath of Lyliss
cards.text: _LEADER_NAME_ can suffer one damage point to cast a spell instead of paying the COST of the spell in focus points. Each spell can be cast once as a result of Wrath of Lyliss. Additionally, _LEADER_NAME_ can suffer one damage point to boost an attack or damage roll instead of spending a focus point. Wrath of Lyliss lasts for one round.

cards.name: Zero Hour
cards.text: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range, one friendly Faction model in _LEADER_NAME_’s control range can target the enemy model with a basic attack. Zero Hour attack rolls are boosted. A model can only attack as a result of Zero Hour once per game. Zero Hour lasts for one round.
